method: Approximate surface regions: smooth nearest-cavity distance classification at each original ventricular-wall vertex; distance to cavity vertex samples, not an expert-labelled tissue segmentation. Basal highlight is an illustrative superior band. Septum is a schematic internal marker at the median region between nearby left/right cavity surfaces; not an anatomical septal mesh.
